decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system carries heavy certification and engineering investment and long defense-related customer commitments, so management persists with it as part of its robust specialist lighting offer.

The second generation of a core interior luminaire was launched publicly as newly arrived and fits the announced LED and efficiency direction, so its reduced prominence is read as normal portfolio maturing rather than failure.
The firm actively promoted this microprismatic pendant as a latest release in 2024, a fresh and visible public commitment central to its ergonomic, standards-compliant office lighting strategy.

Although its sibling HMI searchlight was already dropped, this marine searchlight still embodies sunk marine certification investment and remains visible on the website, so management attributes weak results to temporary niche demand and keeps it for now.
